Select IC50 activity records for human Histone deacetylase 2 (CHEMBL1937). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter by target CHEMBL1937 and standard_type IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (docs.pubmed_id preferred, fallback to docs.doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate.
